title: {{TITLE}}
blueprint: 2-3 sentences: theme, core loop, controls, and where the midgame and rewarded ads trigger.
description: Store-page description for the CrazyGames submission form (2-4 sentences, no links).

controls.desktop: WASD / Arrow keys to move, Space to dash, P to pause
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere on the left to move, tap the button to dash

ads.midgame: Before a new run starts after a game over (the SDK caps it at one every 3 minutes)
ads.rewarded: Optional 'Double coins' on the game-over screen, once per run; hidden when ads are unavailable

quality.hook: What makes this game different from the top 3 CrazyGames games in its genre (name them). A reskin of an existing game is not a hook.
quality.onboarding: How a first-time player learns the game inside gameplay within 30 seconds (guided first level, ghost hand, highlighted target), and how it can be skipped.
quality.art_style: One coherent look for models, UI, icons and covers (e.g. 'chunky low-poly, flat pastel shading, Lilita One titles'). No realistic/cartoon or painted/3D mix.
quality.content: Depth that keeps players for 10+ minutes: number of levels/waves, unlocks, upgrades, bosses, difficulty curve.
quality.name_check: Why the title is distinctive and not easily confused with other games (no plain genre words like 'Merge Defense' or 'Chess').
quality.visual_review: Screenshots and covers you looked at, and the problems you found and fixed: T-poses, z-fighting, unlit or flat-tinted models, overlapping text, unreadable UI at 800x450, AI artifacts on covers.

press.headline: {studio} launches {title}, a ... playable instantly in the browser
press.summary: 2-3 sentences for journalists: what it is, why it is fun, where to play.
press.quote: One quote from the studio team about the idea behind the game.
